app.name: NANOMultipleGitGUI
app.tagline: Multi-account Git GUI for GitHub & GitLab

account.unbound: This repo is not bound to an account — choose one

tabs.missing: This repository folder cannot be found

sidebar.upstreamGone: Upstream branch was deleted on the remote
sidebar.jumpTo: Click to go to the commit

graph.stats: {{total}} commits · up to {{lanes}} lanes · loaded in {{ms}} ms
graph.benchResult: Scroll: {{fps}} fps · p95 {{p95}} ms · draw {{draw}} ms · {{slow}} slow frames
graph.empty: This repository has no commits yet.
graph.notInHistory: Commit {{oid}} is not in the loaded history.

commit.title: Commit / WIP
commit.summaryHint: Keep the summary line under {{limit}} characters
commit.hasConflicts: Resolve and stage conflicted files before committing
commit.noIdentity: user.name / user.email are not set, so git will refuse to commit. Bind an account to this repo (click the account pill) to use its identity, or set them with git config.

common.backendBrowser: Running in a browser (no Tauri backend)

repos.pickNew: Choose a folder for the new repository
repos.welcomeBody: Open an existing repository on this computer or create a new one. Open repositories are restored next time.
repos.missingBody: {{path}} no longer exists, was renamed, or its drive is not connected.
repos.initNotRepoTitle: This folder is not a git repository
repos.initNotRepoBody: {{path}} has no git repository. Create a new repository here?
repos.initNewBody: Initialize a git repository in {{path}} (the folder is created if needed).

tools.gitMissing: Git was not found. Install Git {{min}} or later (https://git-scm.com/downloads), then click Check again.
tools.gitOld: Git {{version}} is too old — {{min}} or later is required. Please update Git.
tools.lfsMissing: Git LFS is not installed — large files in LFS repositories cannot be downloaded. Install git-lfs {{min}} or later (https://git-lfs.com).
tools.lfsOld: Git LFS {{version}} is too old — {{min}} or later is required.

details.title: Commit details
details.author: Author
details.comparedTo: Merge commit — compared with first parent {{oid}}

wip.title: Changes
wip.clean: No changes — the working tree is clean.
wip.discardBody: Unstaged changes in {{count}} files will be lost and new untracked files deleted. This cannot be undone.
wip.rowTitle: Uncommitted changes — click to stage and commit
wip.discardBody_one: Unstaged changes in {{count}} file will be lost and a new untracked file deleted. This cannot be undone.

diff.title: Diff
diff.tooLarge: This diff is too large to show.
diff.noChanges: No changes left on this side.
diff.selectHint: Click +/− lines to select them, Shift+click for a range, then stage or discard the selection.
diff.wholeFileOnly: This change can only be staged as a whole file (new, deleted, renamed or binary).
diff.discardLinesBody: The selected lines go back to their indexed version and the changes are lost. This cannot be undone.
diff.truncated: Long diff — only the first {{count}} lines are shown. Use Inline or Side by side to see everything.
diff.noNewline: No newline at end of file

refs.branchHint: Branch names cannot contain spaces or the characters ~ ^ : ? * [ \.
refs.tagHint: With a message an annotated tag is created, otherwise a lightweight tag.
refs.mergeHint: Choose how to merge. On conflicts the app stops so you can resolve them, then Continue or Abort.

mergeModeHint.fastForward: Just move the branch when possible, otherwise create a merge commit.
mergeModeHint.noFastForward: Keep the branch visible in history (--no-ff).
mergeModeHint.squash: Stage all the changes; you commit them yourself.
mergeModeHint.fastForwardOnly: Refuse when a merge commit would be needed.

refs.resetHardBody: All uncommitted changes (staged or not) are lost, and commits after this point leave the branch. This cannot be undone from the app.
refs.deleteBranchBody: Only the local branch is deleted; the remote branch is not affected.
refs.forceDeleteBody: It has commits that are on no other branch. Force deleting may lose them.
refs.deleteTagBody: Only the local tag is deleted; a tag already pushed stays on the remote.

ops.conflicts: Stopped on conflicts in {{count}} files — resolve, stage, then Continue (or Abort).

merge.upToDate: {{rev}} is already in the current branch.
merge.squashStaged: Staged the changes of {{rev}} — commit them.

ops.conflicts_one: Stopped on conflicts in {{count}} file — resolve, stage, then Continue (or Abort).

failure.currentBranch: Not possible on the checked-out branch
failure.notFullyMerged: The branch is not fully merged
failure.localChanges: Uncommitted changes would be overwritten — commit or stash first
failure.nonFastForward: The remote has newer commits — pull first
failure.staleLease: The remote branch changed since the last fetch
failure.permissionDenied: This account has no access to the repository — switch accounts or request access

stash.createDesc: Shelve uncommitted changes and bring them back later with Pop.
stash.keepIndexHint: Staged changes are stashed too, but also left in the index and working tree
stash.conflicts: Applying {{name}} caused conflicts in {{count}} files: {{files}}. The stash was kept.
stash.dropBody: Changes in stash "{{message}}" will be lost. This cannot be undone in the app yet.

lfs.notUsed: This repo does not use Git LFS yet
lfs.nestedOnly: Declared in {{file}} — edit that file to untrack
lfs.trackDesc: Adds the pattern to the root .gitattributes. Matching files are stored with LFS from the next time they are staged.
lfs.patternInvalid: Invalid pattern: it must not be empty, have leading/trailing spaces, start with - # ! or contain "
lfs.untrackBody: The pattern is removed from .gitattributes. Files already committed stay LFS pointers in history; only new content is affected.
lfs.needsInstall: LFS hooks are not installed for this repo
lfs.install: Install LFS hooks for this repo
lfs.installHint: Runs git lfs install --local — this repo only, global config is untouched
lfs.installed: LFS hooks installed for this repo
lfs.missingTool: This repo uses LFS but git-lfs is not installed — LFS files will stay pointers
lfs.error: Could not read the LFS status: {{message}}

guard.titleSuggest: {{count}} files should be stored with Git LFS
guard.desc: Large files committed directly bloat the repository forever. Track them with LFS so git only stores a small pointer.
guard.blockNote: {{count}} files exceed the hard limit of {{size}} — the push would be rejected, so they cannot be committed as is.
guard.restageOnly: No new pattern needed — already-tracked files are re-staged
guard.commitAnywayBlocked: Unavailable: some files exceed the provider's hard limit
guard.trackFailed: Could not track with LFS, the commit was stopped: {{message}}

remote.fetchTip: Fetch all remotes (with tags, pruning deleted branches)
remote.pullTip: Pull the current branch from its upstream (merge, fast-forward when possible)

pulled.rebased: Pulled and rebased local commits on top.

remote.pushUnavailable: No branch or remote to push to
remote.forceBody: The remote history is overwritten with your local history. With --force-with-lease git refuses if someone pushed commits you have not fetched.
remote.pushUpToDate: The remote already has these commits.
remote.branchTip: Create a new branch at HEAD

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.empty: No terminal for this repository yet.
terminal.exited: Process exited with code {{code}}. Press Enter to restart.
terminal.exitedUnknown: Process exited. Press Enter to restart.
terminal.account: Git commands in this terminal run as this account
terminal.noAccount: No account bound — git uses your global config

transfers.title: Transfer queue
transfers.confirmBody: Will upload {{count}} LFS files · {{size}} · as account
transfers.confirmNote: This is an upper bound: files the server already has are skipped. You can cancel midway; the next push uploads only what is missing.
transfers.noAccount: no account bound (using this machine's git config)
transfers.lfsNothingToUpload: The server already has every LFS file.
transfers.estimateFailed: Could not estimate the LFS upload: {{message}}
transfers.diskWarning: Only {{free}} free on the disk, about {{needed}} needed.
transfers.cancelled: Transfer cancelled. Running it again transfers only what is missing.

noPermission.title: Account {{account}} has no permission to write LFS objects to this repository.
noPermission.hint: Switch to an account with write access (account button in the top bar) and retry.

authRequired.title: No valid LFS credentials (the token is missing or expired).
authRequired.hint: Sign in to {{account}} again, then retry.

quotaExceeded.title: The LFS storage or bandwidth quota of the account/organization is used up.
quotaExceeded.hint: Buy more LFS data on the provider's billing page:

objectTooLarge.title: A file is larger than the server allows.
objectTooLarge.hint: Split it into smaller parts or store it elsewhere (release asset, bucket…).

lfsDisabled.title: Git LFS is disabled for this project.
lfsDisabled.hint: Enable Git LFS in the project's Settings → General → Visibility, project features, permissions:

notFound.title: Repository or LFS endpoint not found (or {{account}} cannot see it).
notFound.hint: Check the remote URL and the account bound to the repository.

rateLimited.title: The server is rate limiting requests.

network.title: Network error or timeout during the LFS transfer.
network.hint: Retry; if it keeps failing, lower the parallel transfers (lfs.concurrenttransfers).

missingObject.title: An LFS object is missing on this machine, so it cannot be uploaded.
missingObject.hint: Download all LFS objects (git lfs fetch --all), then push again.

insufficientDiskSpace.title: Not enough disk space for the LFS files.
insufficientDiskSpace.hint: Free some space, or choose “Download anyway” if you are sure.

other.title: The LFS transfer failed.
other.hint: See the error details below, then retry.

cmd.title: Command palette
cmd.description: Type to find a command, Enter to run it.
cmd.promptHint: Press Enter to confirm, Backspace on an empty box to go back.

graph.gotoInvalid: A SHA is 4–40 hex characters (0-9, a-f).

switcher.noRepo: Open a repository to choose an account
switcher.onceHint: The next commit/push uses the chosen account; the binding stays
switcher.unbound: Account binding removed from the repository

banner.createRule: Create a rule for this folder/host…

commitAs.configDiffers: The repo's git config uses {{email}} — git outside the app will commit with this email
commitAs.unbound: No account bound — using the repo's git config

cmd.pushLater: Account chosen for the next push — press Push when ready

manager.title: Accounts
manager.description: GitHub/GitLab sign-in, commit identities and rules that pick the account.

health.scopesUnknown: Fine-grained token: permissions are per repository
health.optionalMissing: For more features (e.g. SSH key upload) grant: {{scopes}}

list.orderHint: This order maps to the Ctrl+Alt+1..9 shortcuts.
list.empty: No accounts yet. Add a GitHub or GitLab account to get started.
list.deleteBody: Its token and refresh token are removed from the OS keychain, and its identities, rules and repository bindings are deleted. SSH keys are kept. The token is not revoked on GitHub/GitLab — revoke it there if needed.

identities.title: Commit identities
identities.empty: No identity yet. Commits use your own git config.
identities.deleteBody: Delete {{identity}}. Rules and repositories using it fall back to the default identity.
identities.name: Name

name.invalid: The name must not contain < or >

email.duplicate: This account already has this email

providers.hint: GitHub.com and GitLab.com are built in. Self-hosted servers are added when you sign in to them.
providers.name: Display name
providers.clientIdBuiltin: Using the app's built-in client ID. Enter your own to override it.
providers.clientIdHint: Leave empty to sign in with personal access tokens only.
providers.registerApp: Register an OAuth app on this server
providers.redirectHint: Register exactly this Redirect URI in the GitLab application (untick "Confidential"):
providers.deviceHint: GitHub: create an OAuth App and tick "Enable Device Flow"; no client secret is needed.

error.warn: The warning threshold must be a positive whole number
error.block: The block threshold must be ≥ the warning threshold
error.port: The port must be between 1024 and 65535

rules.hint: Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match decides a repository's account.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Example: github.com/acme-corp → Work account.
rules.title: Rules
rules.formHint: Fill in at least one condition; every filled condition must match.

error.match: At least one condition is required

rules.testNone: No rule matches — the repository stays unbound.

settings.writeIdentity: Write the identity to the repository's .git/config
settings.writeIdentityHint: So VS Code, the git CLI… outside the app commit with the right name and email.
settings.writeSshHint: Git outside the app also uses the account's SSH key.

wizard.title: Add account
wizard.noClientId: This server has no OAuth client ID yet, so browser sign-in is unavailable. Use a personal access token (PAT), or enter the client ID of an OAuth app you registered.

methodHint.device: Enter a short code on the provider's website.
methodHint.pkce: Opens the browser, then comes back to the app.
methodHint.pat: Paste a token you created. Good for self-hosted servers or orgs that block OAuth apps.

device.instructions: {{url}} is open in your browser and the code below is on your clipboard — paste it there and click Authorize:
device.waiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…

pkce.opened: The browser is open. Sign in and click Authorize to continue.
pkce.redirectHint: The GitLab application must have exactly this Redirect URI:
pkce.waiting: Waiting for the browser to come back…

pat.scopesHint: When creating the token, select these scopes:
pat.createLink: Create a token on the website
pat.fineGrained: Org blocks OAuth apps? Use a fine-grained token with Contents (Read and write) on the repositories you need.

error.malformed: The token must not contain spaces

error.unauthorized: The token is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.oauthRestricted: The organization blocks this OAuth app. Ask an owner to approve it, or use a fine-grained token.
error.rateLimited: Too many API calls, try again in a few minutes.
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your network or proxy.
error.denied: You declined the authorization in the browser.
error.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Try again.
error.timedOut: Timed out waiting for the browser. Try again.
error.deviceUnsupported: This server or OAuth app does not support the device flow.
error.stateMismatch: The sign-in response did not match this attempt. Try again.
error.revoked: The session expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
error.loopback: Cannot open the local sign-in port: {{message}}
error.missingClientId: This server has no OAuth client ID yet. Sign in with a personal access token.
error.pkceUnsupported: Browser sign-in is for GitLab; use the device code for GitHub.
error.unknownFlow: This sign-in attempt has ended. Start again.

ssh.title: SSH keys — {{account}}
ssh.description: SSH keys are used for repositories bound to this account with the SSH transport. The app injects the default key through GIT_SSH_COMMAND, so no host alias is needed in ~/.ssh/config and remotes keep the plain git@host:org/repo.git form.
ssh.empty: This account has no SSH key yet. Generate a new key or import an existing one.

generateForm.title: Generate an Ed25519 key
generateForm.commentHint: Leave empty to use the default identity's email.
generateForm.passphraseHint: The passphrase is saved in the OS keychain so git can use the key without prompting.

importForm.title: Import a private key
importForm.passphraseRequired: This key is protected by a passphrase — enter it and try again.
importForm.alreadyKnown: This key is already in the account.
importForm.alreadyOther: This key is attached to another account.
importForm.publicMismatch: The .pub file next to the key does not match the private key — the public key from the private key was used.
importForm.note: Your file is not modified: the app stores a copy in its data folder, readable by the current user only.

uploadResult.uploaded: Public key uploaded to the provider.
uploadResult.alreadyRegistered: The key is already on this account — marked as uploaded.
uploadResult.usedByAnotherAccount: The provider says this key is registered to another account. A key can belong to one user only — generate a new key for this account.
uploadResult.missingScope: The token cannot add SSH keys (needs {{scopes}}). Sign in again granting it, or copy the public key and paste it in the provider's SSH settings.
uploadResult.missingScopeUnknown: The provider refused to add the key: the token lacks permission. Sign in again with SSH key management access, or paste the public key on the provider manually.
uploadResult.tokenPermissionMissing: The fine-grained token lacks the "Git SSH keys" (write) permission. Update the token or paste the public key on the provider manually.
uploadResult.noToken: The account has no token — sign in again to upload the key.
uploadResult.unauthorized: The token expired or was revoked — sign in again.

testResult.mismatch: This key authenticates as @{{user}}, not @{{expected}}. Git will use that account's permissions over SSH.
testResult.deployKey: This key is a deploy key of {{repo}}, not a key of @{{expected}}.
testResult.denied: The provider rejected the key (Permission denied). Upload the public key to this account.
testResult.hostKeyFailed: The host key of {{host}} could not be verified.
testResult.passphraseNeeded: The key needs a passphrase that is not saved.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete SSH key?
deleteConfirm.body: Removes key {{fingerprint}} from the app: the key file in the app data folder and its passphrase in the keychain. The key stays registered on the provider — remove it there if you no longer use it.

onboarding.title: Import existing configuration
onboarding.subtitle: Finds identities, rules and SSH keys in ~/.gitconfig, ~/.ssh/config, gh and glab. Read-only — no file is changed.
onboarding.nothingFound: Nothing to import was found. You can add an account right away.
onboarding.noAccountsHint: Identities and rules belong to an account. Sign in first ("Sign in again" in the gh/glab section, or "Add account"), then pick an account for each item.
onboarding.needsAccount: Choose an account to import this item
onboarding.aliasUnnecessary: Alias {{alias}} → {{host}} is no longer needed: the app picks the key per account, so remotes can use the real host again.
onboarding.signInNote: The app does not reuse gh/glab tokens — sign in again to add the account.
onboarding.plainToken: The CLI stores this token in plain text in its config file.

warning.includeLoop: Include nesting too deep or cyclic

code.passphraseRequired: The key has a passphrase — enter it and try again
code.keyOfAnotherAccount: The key belongs to another account
code.identityNotFound: The rule's identity was not found

clone.title: Clone repository
clone.description: Pick a repository from any account, or paste a URL — the matching account is guessed.
clone.emptyNoAccounts: No repositories yet — sign in to an account, or paste a URL below.

listErrorCode.rateLimited: rate limit reached, try again later

clone.guessMany: → {{count}} accounts can clone this: choose one
clone.guessNone: No account for this host — git's own credentials will be used.
clone.spaceInsufficient: Not enough disk space: about {{size}} needed.
clone.spaceLow: Less than 1 GB free on this drive.
clone.cancelled: Clone cancelled; the partial folder was removed.
clone.lfsPartialFailed: Cloned, but downloading the selected LFS files failed: {{message}}

error.urlRequired: Choose a repository or paste a URL.
error.urlInvalid: This is not a URL git can clone.
error.destNotEmpty: The folder already exists and is not empty.
error.patternInvalid: Enter an LFS pattern, e.g. Assets/UI/**.

commit.title: Before you commit
commit.identity: The commit will be authored as {{name}} <{{email}}>
commit.noIdentity: No identity (user.name / user.email) is set for this commit.

reason.ruleAccount: A rule assigns this repository to the account {{label}}.
reason.notAccountEmail: This email does not belong to the bound account {{label}}.
reason.personalEmailOnOrgRepo: This is a personal email but the repository belongs to an organisation.

commit.unboundTitle: This repository is not bound to an account
commit.unboundDesc: The commit will use the identity from your git configuration.
commit.unverified: {{email}} is not verified on the account {{label}} — the commit will not be linked to your profile.
commit.signing: The repository enables commit.gpgsign but no user.signingkey is configured — the commit may fail or not be signed.

push.title: Before you push
push.permissionDenied: The account {{label}} cannot push to this remote (access: {{level}}). The push will be rejected — switch accounts or ask for write access.
push.permissionDeniedNoLabel: The account in use cannot push to this remote. The push will be rejected.
push.permissionUnknown: Push permission could not be checked ({{reason}}).
push.authorsTitle_one: {{count}} commit has a different author than the current identity
push.authorsTitle_other: {{count}} commits have a different author than the current identity
push.authorsDesc: They will show a name/email other than {{email}}.
push.fixLast: Fix author of the last commit
push.fixShared: Some commits are already on another remote branch — shared history is never rewritten
push.fixLastUnavailable: The last commit already has the right author or is pushed
push.blobsDesc: Warning threshold {{warn}}{{block}}. Move large files to Git LFS before pushing.
push.migrateDesc: Runs git lfs migrate import on the unpushed commits only: {{paths}}
push.sharedBlobsDesc: The app never rewrites shared history. To fix it: agree with your team, then run git lfs migrate import --everything (requires a force push), or remove the file from history with git filter-repo. Everyone will need to re-clone afterwards.
push.pushBlocked: Cannot push: the account has no write access or a file exceeds the hard limit
